prompt_fields.subject: The top of a thick yeek bamboo hut wall seen from straight above: a dense, continuous mat of dark dried palm-frond thatch laid over bundled bamboo culms, with short cut bamboo ends and dark twisted-fibre rope bindings showing through here and there. Irregular, overlapping, slightly shaggy; no single long straight stripe, plank, board, row or tile pattern.
prompt_fields.palette: Dark weathered umber-brown and smoky olive-brown thatch, deep brown-black gaps between bundles, a few muted dull-tan bamboo ends and sparse desaturated green rope. Overall value mid-dark: clearly darker than green jungle grass and a pale tan hut floor mat; never bright straw yellow, never grass green, never grey stone.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a solid dark blocking hut wall, clearly darker and rougher than any walkable floor, distinct from jungle trees by its brown fibrous thatch-and-bamboo texture rather than leafy canopy, and distinct from a wooden floor by having no parallel boards.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead material filling the whole square, even density everywhere, no single dominant feature, no border, horizon, sky, cliff edge or cast shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Used only as the top of Irkkk bamboo hut wall cells, which block movement and sight. Paint no door, opening, path, stairs, hazard, character or decoration mask.

prompt_fields.subject: A SINGLE short straight section of a yeek bamboo hut wall: a solid palisade of thick vertical bamboo culms standing tightly side by side with visible nodes, bound by two horizontal bands of twisted dark rope, capped along its top by a thick bundle of dried palm-frond thatch. A heavy, continuous wall block, not a fence with gaps.
prompt_fields.palette: Weathered dark honey-brown and umber bamboo, darker umber shadows between culms, dull olive-green rope bands, dark brown thatch cap. The front face of the culms is mid-dark; nothing bright straw yellow, no pale cream.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels the face must read as vertical bamboo culms of a blocking hut wall, clearly darker than a tan hut floor and green jungle grass, and clearly different from a tree trunk or a wooden plank door.
prompt_fields.composition: One wide coherent wall section in overhead three-quarter tabletop view, placed in the exact CENTRE of a mostly empty transparent canvas. The wall occupies ONLY the middle 70% of the canvas width: its leftmost point about 15% from the left edge and its rightmost point about 15% from the right edge, with fully transparent empty space on both sides. Thatch-capped top from about 20% to 40% of the image height, the vertical culm face below it down to about 85%. Nothing, not a leaf tip, rope end or shadow, extends into the outer 12% band on any side. Transparent corners. No cut-off wall.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Irkkk hut wall: blocks movement and sight. No door, window, opening, mask, skin, weapon or other decoration; no character, sign or hazard.

prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a flat, walkable, calm hut floor that game pieces can stand on; low contrast so characters stay readable on it; distinct from green jungle grass by its warm tan colour and from the dark bamboo walls by being much lighter.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead floor material filling the whole square, even density everywhere, no single dominant feature, no border, rug edge, wall, object, fire pit or shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Walkable hut floor only. Paint no furniture, fire, pot, door, stairs, hazard, character, symbol or text.
